themes.intro:
Personalized Safari Nursery Wall Art for a nursery or kids room: a set of three prints with your child's name in the middle.

You receive all 6 watercolor safari animal portraits right away, and we make the name poster for you: the name in brush lettering over a big soft initial letter, in blue, pink and sage. Hang any two portraits beside it, or print them all.
